store.how_h2: From first browse to confirmed order — in three steps.
store.s1_d: No public self-signup. Tell us about your company; our team reviews and verifies your business, then opens up pricing for your account.

store.s3_d: Send the cart as a request. An operator reviews the lines, confirms availability with the factory, and finalizes — no inflated middlemen.

store.ab_title: A wholesale marketplace, run with care.
store.ab_lead: We connect verified manufacturers across Türkiye with international buyers worldwide — catalogued carefully, priced fairly, and built to be found.
store.ab_mission_h: Cross-border wholesale is opaque. We made it legible.
store.ab_mission_p1: Sourcing across borders usually means scattered WhatsApp threads, prices that change with your accent, and specs you can't compare. A buyer in Amman has no clean way to weigh a motor from İzmir against one from Bursa.
store.ab_mission_p2: Tavkil replaces the back-and-forth with one closed marketplace: every manufacturer vetted, every listing catalogued with identical fields, and clear, factory-direct pricing shown after approval — never improvised.
store.ab_corridor_p: From the industrial clusters of İzmir, Bursa and Gaziantep to İstanbul and Konya, we catalogue makers within reach of our own team — then ship to buyers worldwide. Verification means a visit, not a form.
store.ab_pr_h: Three principles the marketplace is built on.
store.pr1_d: No manufacturer appears until our team has checked the workshop, the paperwork and a sample. Verification is a visit, not a checkbox.
store.pr2_d: Every listing carries the same fields — origin, MOQ, lead time, certifications — so a buyer compares products, not sales pitches.
store.pr3_d: Prices are shown only after we verify your business. No public prices, no middlemen.
store.foot_about: A closed B2B wholesale marketplace connecting verified manufacturers in Türkiye with international buyers worldwide — at factory-direct prices.
